authorization.statement: The operator asked to implement the plan and to record its graph, specifications and ADRs in the backlog-graph schema.
authorization.scope: Materialize the contracts and the program; implement the consolidated plan; research only through experiments.

packages.title: Honest capabilities and a reproducible benchmark

acceptance_criteria.AC-01: Every advertised capability identifies its implementation, contract, verification method and limits; planning is not proof.
acceptance_criteria.AC-02: The three Python counterexamples are reproducible without external services and recorded before/after the fix.
acceptance_criteria.AC-03: The benchmark records version, root, corpus, environment, complete process, p50/p95/p99 and sample count without promoting a target to a measurement.
acceptance_criteria.AC-04: The configuration reveals the covered spec/code paths; absence of a SPEC is declared, not confused with absence of code.

packages.implementation: Versioned catalog served by capabilities and doctor; replace absolute claims and wrong links. Small local benchmark; heavy profiles use the workstation. Existing tests and counterexamples are distinct evidence.

packages.title: Python identity and structural resolution

acceptance_criteria.AC-01: IDs preserve repo/path/lexical scope; homonyms and nested scopes do not merge.
acceptance_criteria.AC-02: Absolute and relative imports and aliases resolve through the complete module/source root; ambiguity never picks the first basename.
acceptance_criteria.AC-03: Supported local calls produce the correct dependency; an unused import does not become a function dependency.
acceptance_criteria.AC-04: Each occurrence/relation declares its origin, range and resolution state; external/dynamic/unknown does not get a fictitious endpoint.
acceptance_criteria.AC-05: Correct legacy APIs/IDs remain compatible; indexed code outside governed_paths does not become a blocking orphan.

packages.implementation: Extract references with the native AST, resolve them within the module index, and separate syntactic certainty from a resolved target. DEPENDS_ON_STATIC stays a compatible projection; dynamic coverage is not promised.

packages.title: SQLite read model, snapshots and minimal MCP

acceptance_criteria.AC-01: The index materializes symbols, relations, documents and metadata in SQLite WAL; a query does not run AST parsing, a full scan or a structural subprocess.
acceptance_criteria.AC-02: BEGIN IMMEDIATE publication is atomic, content is deterministic and revision_seq is monotonic; an idempotent operation does not pollute generations and K=1 retention remains.
acceptance_criteria.AC-03: The reader uses a consistent snapshot; a wrong root, corruption or an incompatible schema is refused without replacing sources.
acceptance_criteria.AC-04: Coverage, snapshot/freshness and governance are separate states; governance debt does not prevent a faithful representation and parse errors are explicit.
acceptance_criteria.AC-05: The read-only MCP query_causal_graph/get_context_envelope/check_drift uses the same services and includes revision_seq/content_hash; no mutator is exposed.

packages.implementation: stdlib sqlite3 and FTS5 when available, a capability diagnostic when absent. Native state per root with an explicit override; keep hashes before/after the build to detect concurrent writes. The strict JSON cache keeps its contract during migration.

packages.title: Incremental extraction and verifiable freshness

acceptance_criteria.AC-01: After an edit/delete/rename/config/parser change, the incremental graph is equivalent to a full rebuild on the qualification corpus.
acceptance_criteria.AC-02: The delta re-extracts changed files and relinks affected consumers; it removes leftover symbols/edges/FTS rows atomically.
acceptance_criteria.AC-03: Watchers/events are accelerators with reconciliation of lost events; the freshness method, age and coverage are explicit.
acceptance_criteria.AC-04: Strict impact keeps AC-02 fail-closed for stale data; an advisory query never satisfies a gate.
acceptance_criteria.AC-05: Unstable sources/parse errors are not published as complete or fresh; the read model can represent debt without hiding it.

packages.implementation: Cache per extractor/file with fingerprints and resolution dependencies; reparse limited to the delta and transitive rebind according to exports. Do not replace strong verification with mtime without declaring the limit.

packages.title: Budgeted code search and context

acceptance_criteria.AC-01: Exact ID/path/name and text retrieve results with ranges, reasons and the source snapshot; lexical/graph retrieval works without a SPEC or an LLM.
acceptance_criteria.AC-02: refs/neighbors/path/explain respect direction, types, ambiguities, hop/node/byte limits and deterministic ordering.
acceptance_criteria.AC-03: Context selects complete units; mandatory ACs/snippets are never truncated; an excess is refused with a smaller suggested selection.
acceptance_criteria.AC-04: Learned reuse preserves the literal/structural origin and does not hide a better result from the current generation.
acceptance_criteria.AC-05: P95 includes the complete cost per profile; the sub-50ms service and <=300ms CLI targets remain qualification proposals, not a universal guarantee.

packages.implementation: Deterministic router exact→lexical→bounded expansion. FTS5 BM25, no required vectors. Handles with repo/snapshot/budget, the existing strict renderer and compact JSON. Return UNKNOWN/PARTIAL when coverage does not allow an absence.

packages.title: Federated intent and evidence with validity

acceptance_criteria.AC-01: Declarative mapping and assisted rebind preserve the source-qualified SPEC/ADR; conflicts and candidates are not silently promoted.
acceptance_criteria.AC-02: A bundle by diff/ref uses a stable snapshot and the owners' explicit sources; READY metadata does not imply that the body was read.
acceptance_criteria.AC-03: A test reference, a verifies declaration and executed coverage are distinct relations; an isolated JUnit/hash does not become Tier 1.
acceptance_criteria.AC-04: Evidence records the command/executor/configuration/environment/snapshot and the attestation; relevant changes require conservative revalidation.
acceptance_criteria.AC-05: Work/status belong to the Backlog; a source/AC mismatch at admission is refused; the Library catalog only receives pins/hashes of real commits.

packages.implementation: Ingest evidence references produced by the executor; do not build a parallel signer. The valid/needs_revalidation/superseded/invalid states preserve history. Without complete observed dependencies, declare the limits and use a conservative fallback.

packages.title: TypeScript, Rust and an offline viewer

acceptance_criteria.AC-01: TypeScript and Rust have Tree-sitter extractors and a contract per construct/language; the grammar is not presented as full semantic resolution.
acceptance_criteria.AC-02: A supported installation does not require a C/Rust compiler; missing extras are diagnosed, with no silent fallback that invents coverage.
acceptance_criteria.AC-03: A single offline HTML file without a CDN provides the map, filters, path/impact and sources, with a budget and safe escaping.
acceptance_criteria.AC-04: CLI/MCP/SDK/UI represent the same generation and limits; code without a SPEC remains navigable.
acceptance_criteria.AC-05: SCIP is an optional adapter with an explicit subset/version; no mandatory semantic enrichment enters the hot path.

packages.implementation: Grammars through wheels and pure extractors; incremental read-only UI by selection, bounded datasets, clickable origin. Completes the ratified phase; not optional for declaring the complete vision.

packages.title: Context services for hooks and doctor

acceptance_criteria.AC-01: Read-only services expose root/capability/coverage/snapshot with a budget to existing adapters.
acceptance_criteria.AC-02: Role/event selects useful, deduplicable context; no Work is chosen and no state is changed by hook inference.
acceptance_criteria.AC-03: MISS/STALE/TIMEOUT and uncovered scope allow bounded recovery without a loop; a known path does not require rediscovery.
acceptance_criteria.AC-04: Doctor distinguishes installation, coverage, index, governance, evidence and effectiveness; a hook registration does not prove execution/delivery.
acceptance_criteria.AC-05: Usefulness is evaluated with paired tasks and the total agent cost; zero LLM/network/full scan in the synchronous handler.

packages.implementation: SpecGraph provides services; the OS composes lifecycle/doctor and the Kernel normalizes events/policy. The detailed operational contract is SPEC-OS-SPECGRAPH-HOOKS-001 in the OS; reuse the existing handlers.

packages.title: Qualification of the complete vision and release

acceptance_criteria.AC-01: Each ADR-001/ADR-059/SPEC-SPECGRAPH-001 obligation points to its implementation, proof and limitation; no planned step becomes delivered.
acceptance_criteria.AC-02: Benchmark profiles pin corpus/commit/config/hardware, >=100 samples and two rounds, with misses/outliers/serialization included.
acceptance_criteria.AC-03: Context savings of >=65% are only advertised if a compatible experiment supports the claim; task success is a condition.
acceptance_criteria.AC-04: Migration, clean installation, concurrency, mutations and real hosts are qualified; isolated green tests do not qualify integration.
acceptance_criteria.AC-05: The Graphify comparison uses the same task/corpus/budget/version; without running the comparison, do not claim superiority.

packages.implementation: The catalog and release documents are projections of evidence. Experiments may legitimately be rejected without blocking the core; X2 is a required contract. Publication and pins are explicit steps after qualification.

packages.title: Context selection by usefulness and risk

acceptance_criteria.AC-01: A deterministic scorer selects complete units under the budget and mandatory constraints, with auditable reasons.
acceptance_criteria.AC-02: A paired experiment compares a contract+dependencies baseline with the same budget and measures success/total cost.
acceptance_criteria.AC-03: Without a gain in two rounds, or with an additional warm cost >20ms, reject the scorer and keep the simple selector.

packages.implementation: Exploratory hypothesis based on H-18 and Aider's selective map; the heuristic is not a statistically proven information gain.

packages.title: Scoped absence and answer coverage

acceptance_criteria.AC-01: An empty answer identifies the snapshot, scope, method/constructs, exclusions, unresolved items and budget.
acceptance_criteria.AC-02: A reference outside the index or an unresolved dispatch produces UNKNOWN/PARTIAL, never a universal proof of absence.
acceptance_criteria.AC-03: Full syntactic coverage is not confused with semantic completeness; the hook checks the substitute's real coverage.

packages.implementation: Required core contract with an ergonomics experiment; static relations only assert what the supported method observed.

packages.title: Temporal context deltas by handle

acceptance_criteria.AC-01: The client handle binds repo/Work/snapshot/IDs/digests; the diff includes every changed and withdrawn unit.
acceptance_criteria.AC-02: Expiration, a wrong root/Work and a delta larger than the envelope return refresh/revalidation; the store's K=1 stays intact.
acceptance_criteria.AC-03: Measure bytes and the task; exploratory target of a median <=20% of the envelope after a localized edit, reject if the delta is larger in >30% of cases.

packages.implementation: Explicitly activated X3 SDK experiment: bounded client handles and complete-unit temporal deltas, with full refresh for invalid/expired hints and non-smaller deltas. Eight frozen offline context tasks reconstruct the fresh full oracle. Median whole-response ratio 43.19% missed the exploratory 20% target; automatic adoption rejected. No model delivery-quality or invoice/cache savings claim.

packages.title: Witness chain for an architectural violation

acceptance_criteria.AC-01: A real import/layer contract returns the minimal supported violating chain, with source/range and ADR.
acceptance_criteria.AC-02: An ambiguous/inferred relation does not support a strict block; proposed cuts stay advisory and simulation is distinguished from a correct refactoring.
acceptance_criteria.AC-03: Without a real contract or measurable value, record a rejection; do not build a mandatory global repair solver.

packages.implementation: Explicit optional diagnostic over the existing bounded outgoing static path query. Actual ADR-057 Runtime import boundary and its unchanged AST oracle remain authoritative. Ten offline seeded cases: two supported chains, seven inconclusive cases and one whole-response refusal, with no unexpected definite findings. Existing enforcement is sufficient; only opt-in explanation is added. Reject a global solver, new policy engine, automatic gate or repair planner; no human-time or delivery-quality claim.

packages.title: Candidate tests and proof debt

acceptance_criteria.AC-01: Selection distinguishes a static reference from executed/attested coverage and makes blocks without proof explicit.
acceptance_criteria.AC-02: Known mutations compare the selection with the full suite; omitting a relevant test suspends selective qualification.
acceptance_criteria.AC-03: Incomplete coverage/config/env requires a fallback; a heuristic set is not a global minimum and does not waive mandatory tests.
acceptance_criteria.AC-04: Measure the capture and execution cost; exploratory target of a median <=30% of the suite time without reducing correctness.

packages.implementation: Per-block dependencies inspired by Testmon; the executor owns execution and attestation. SpecGraph proposes a small experiment with reasons.

title: SpecGraph: complete, fast and verifiable project intelligence
